- [AetherSynth & Flow](https://ardhyanovri.my.id/projects/aether-synth-flow): Native Swift 6 and Metal spatial audio synthesizer (iOS 18, watchOS 11, visionOS 2, macOS 15, AUv3) with 90 Hz Reverse-Z .greaterEqual, < 12 ms latency (7.67 ms slew / 9.1 ms E2E), chi_max = 16 (0 heap allocs, 2.99e-10 DMRG), 51.22 dB PML waveguide, 30.56 dB SPWVD (49.90 dB midpoint, 0 RT heap allocs), 14.65% drop & 95 ms Pareto jitter (0 false spikes), -91.6% global loads & < 6.5 ms GPU governor, and 12/12 SHA-256 stages.
- [FerrumKV](https://ardhyanovri.my.id/projects/ferrum-kv): Distributed RESP3 key-value store, 3-node Raft consensus engine, HNSW SQ8 vector search (173,007 VSEARCH/s, 93.3% Recall@5), and disk LSM-tree written in pure safe Rust (std only, #![forbid(unsafe_code)], 564,993 MIXED ops/s, 505,716 GET/s, 307,853 INCR/s, -95.46% SET p99.9 tail reduction to 7.16 ms, 64 CachePadded shards, 16-stripe tx_exec_fence, RwLock<LsmState>, and RespParser::parse_flat_command + get_into zero-copy parser).
- [Career Test Arena](https://github.com/vanovri/career-test-arena): Offline-ready cognitive and technical exam simulator and engineering calculator with 45 verified questions (UT Cognitive, UT Tech & Infra 14929, Formulatrix SIE), 8 STAR cards, automated claim-boundary scanner, and 7/7 pytest suite.
